label: RBv1
reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system shows the settlement as `pending_approval` with a payout of €1,700. A human claims handler must approve it before any payment is made. Claim reference: RBv1-CLM-B_r5.

**Facts recorded**
- Policy VER-1002 is held by Lucas Bernard. The vehicle is a Renault Clio (2023) with a market value of €16,500. The driving licence date is 2 September 2024. The Policy Schedule lists C1, C2 and C3.
- Incident date: 14 October 2026. Reported: 15 October 2026.
- The customer changed lanes on the ring road, misjudged the distance and hit the car next to him. He states it was his fault.
- The other driver, Ms. Laurent, is named. The email says she and the customer signed the accident report.
- The garage quoted €2,400 "to repair my car", so the claim is treated as damage to the customer's own car under C2.
- Documents in the claim file: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf and accident_report_signed.pdf. I have not opened these files.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 is listed on the Policy Schedule and covers damage to the insured vehicle after a collision. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Reporting:** The claim was reported one day after the incident, within the 5-day limit. No late-report referral is needed. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Required documents:** For C2 these are photos, a repair quote and an accident report signed by both drivers when a third party is involved. All three were provided, so nothing is missing. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Exclusions:** The email gives no sign of alcohol, drugs, racing, intentional damage, a missing licence or wear. No exclusion is applied. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Not-at-fault waiver:** Does not apply, because the customer was at fault. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Young-driver surcharge:** The licence was under 3 years old on the incident date, so an extra €400 applies on top of the €300 standard C2 deductible. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Assessor:** The repair cost is above €1,500, so an independent assessor must inspect the vehicle. The system has booked a visit for 18 October 2026. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Compensation:** Repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. Payment follows approval by a claims handler. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>

**Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Deductible: €700 (€300 standard C2 plus €400 young-driver surcharge)
- Payout: €1,700 (€2,400 minus €700)
- Assessor required: Yes, booked for 18 October 2026

**Point for the handler**
- Ms. Laurent's car was also damaged. Any claim for her damage would fall under C1 (third-party liability), which is on the Policy Schedule. No C1 claim or amount was provided, so it has not been assessed. It may need to be raised with the customer or with Ms. Laurent's insurer.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Bernard,
>
> Thank you for reporting your accident of 14 October 2026 and for sending your documents. We have booked an independent assessor to inspect your car on 18 October 2026. Once the assessment is complete, a claims handler will review your claim before any payment is made. Please keep your car available for the visit. If you have any questions, please reply to this email.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team
